title: Auto Loans: GAP Cancellation and Refunds
content:
GAP waiver coverage on an Auto Loans account is optional. This policy covers how the borrower ends it and how much of the charge comes back.

## Cancelling

The borrower may cancel GAP coverage whenever they choose, for as long as the loan remains open. The cancellation is the borrower's own decision, recorded as a GAP cancellation request that the borrower confirms. When a loan with GAP still in force is paid off ahead of schedule, the payoff date counts as the date of cancellation.

## Refund amount

- **Inside the full-refund period.** A cancellation within the product's full-refund period refunds the entire GAP charge. The period runs in calendar days, day 1 being the day after the funding date; a cancellation dated no later than the funding date plus the full-refund period earns the whole charge back. That last day still qualifies.
- **After the full-refund period.** The refund is the GAP charge multiplied by the number of whole months left until the scheduled maturity date and divided by the term in months, rounded half-up to the cent, and then reduced by the product's cancellation fee. When that result is zero or negative, nothing is refunded.

## Limits on refunds

Each loan receives no more than one GAP refund. The refund is paid into one of the borrower's PCB checking accounts or by official check; it is never credited against the loan balance.

## Worked example (a made-up GAP charge and fee)

Take a GAP charge of 600.00 on a 60-month loan, cancelled after the full-refund period with 36 whole months left to maturity, and a cancellation fee of 40.00. The prorated amount is 600.00 multiplied by 36 and divided by 60, which is 360.00; less 40.00 the refund is 320.00. With only 3 whole months left, the prorated amount would be 30.00, and less 40.00 it falls below zero, so no refund is made.

## Window boundary (abstract dates)

For a loan funded on day F with a full-refund period of P days, a cancellation dated F plus P receives the whole charge; one dated F plus P plus one is prorated.
